chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Hammad from Ibn Miskin from Mushamil ibn Sa'd from Abu Baseer from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) regarding
a man who left his parents. He (peace be upon him) said: 'It is from three shares: for the mother one share, and for the father two shares.'
ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of parents when a person dies without children or a spouse?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi clarifies the specific distribution of the estate when only parents survive the deceased, assigning one-third to the mother and two-thirds to the father. This ruling is derived from the general Quranic verse on inheritance (4:11) and is consistent with the consensus of Shia jurists, who view the father's share as the remainder after the mother's fixed portion is allocated. It highlights the father's role as the primary heir in the absence of descendants or a spouse.

en.hubeali:
Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hassan Bin Hammad, from Ibn Maskeyn, from Mushmail Bin Saeed, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regard
a man who left his parents. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is from a third – a share for the mother with one share, and for the father, two shares’.
en.sarwar: 3. Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hassan ibn Hammad from ibn Miskin from Mushma‘il ibn Sa‘d from abu Basir who has narrated the following: “About the case of a man who dies and leaves behind his parents, abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘It is from three shares, one share for the mother and two for the father.’”
